summary.zh: 体检并改写领英资料与标题
summary.en: Audit and rewrite a LinkedIn profile and headline.

description.zh: 检查 LinkedIn 个人主页的标题、简介、经历和精选区，找出缺失项并重写较弱的部分。适合求职、转换方向，或资料长期没有更新时使用。
description.en: Reviews the headline, About, experience and Featured sections of a LinkedIn profile, flags gaps and rewrites weak parts. Use it when job hunting or after leaving the profile untouched for a long time.
